verdict.rationale: Mangopay sends webhook notifications when specific events occur on API objects, configurable per event type in the Dashboard (Developers > Webhooks), but any resulting action must be built in your own application. It also lets you define custom fraud-detection rules, including rules based on browsing-session traits, which act automatically on suspicious activity. There is no evidence of a general-purpose, user-defined event-to-action rules engine. Missing for 10: native configurable event→action automation beyond fraud rules, documentation of what actions rules can take, independent or hands-on corroboration.
